title: _rejection
description: A record of a batch of process events that the engine rejected because the brain went beyond what it was asked to do. It is a business error, not a system error, so it is recorded to be fixed (the process, the instructions or the brain), and versioned in git. Written by the engine. Draft v0.

topic.description: Topic of the published event, as {entity}:{operation}.

subscription.description: A copy of the _subscription that was called, to tell which brain returned the rejected events. A copy and not a reference, because subscriptions are runtime records: they expire and are deleted by the cleanup script.

event.description: A copy of the published _event, as it was sent. A copy and not a reference, because the queue entry is removed and its id can start over.

returned.description: The process events the brain returned, as received.

violations.description: Why the batch was rejected: one entry per broken check.

index.description: Position of the process event in `returned`.

check.description: The validation that failed: schema (not a valid event or invalid data), scope (it touches something other than the task the brain was asked to work on), approver (an approval by a role not in canApprovedBy), depth (beyond the depth limit).
